content.title: John Mulaney and Olivia Munn's Relationship & Marriage
content.text: Former SNL writer John Mulaney is one of the biggest and most beloved comedians working today. Mulaney has received four Emmys and two WGA awards for his work, including the comedy specials The Top Part (2009), New in Town (2012), The Comeback Kid (2015), Kid Gorgeous (2018) and Baby J (2023). Mulaney discusses the chapters of his romantic life through his stand-up comedy and late-night show appearances.Read More As recent as his August 2024 appearance on Late Night with Seth Meyers, Mulaney described being married to his wife Olivia Munn as the “single greatest time in my life.”Now that Apple TV’s Your Friends and Neighbors (which Munn stars in) is returning for Season 2 on April 3, 2026, we’re likely to hear more anecdotes about the comedian’s marriage. When did Mulaney and Munn meet? How long have they been together? Do they have kids?Here’s everything you need to know about John Mulaney’s wife, Olivia Munn.Related: How to Watch Every John Mulaney Stand-Up Special Table of ContentsWho is John Mulaney's wife?What does John Mulaney's wife, Olivia Munn, do for a living?How did John Mulaney meet his wife, Olivia Munn?When did John Mulaney and Olivia Munn get married?How many kids do John Mulaney and Olivia Munn have? Who is John Mulaney’s wife? The Big Mouth star is currently married to Olivia Munn, 45. The pair knew each other for a decade before they started dating in 2021. The pair tied the knot several years later after Munn gave birth to a son. Munn is of Vietnamese descent on her mother’s side, with German, Irish, and English ancestry on her father’s. “I’ve been in a lot of interesting situations,” Mulaney shared with Meyers. “Marrying into a large Vietnamese family is one of the most fun things I’ve ever done.” 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 What does John Mulaney’s wife, Olivia Munn, do for a living? Olivia Munn is a successful actress. She’s best known for her roles in The X-Men: Apocalypse, The Newsroom, Magic Mike, and The Predator. Munn can be seen in the Apple TV Jon Hamm-led series Your Friends and Neighbors. Munn is also a proud advocate of breast cancer awareness after being diagnosed with breast cancer in 2023. In February 2025, she was named as one of Time‘s 2025 Women of the Year. How did John Mulaney meet his wife, Olivia Munn? Munn first met Mulaney at a wedding in 2013 when he was engaged to ex-wife Anna Marie Tendler. “We were at a wedding together and I was like, ‘Oh my gosh, do you and your fiancé want to go have dinner or something and go hang out?'” she recalled about fangirling over Mulaney in a 2015 HuffPost interview. “At first it was cool, and then I kept going up to him at the wedding like ‘So you having fun?’ I was just so obsessed with hanging out with and talking with him.” In 2021, after Mulaney checked into rehab and separated from Tendler, he and Munn reconnected via church and started dating. When did John Mulaney and Olivia Munn get married? The two were married over the Fourth of July weekend in 2024, in their friend’s home in New York. They were married in front of their toddler son, Malcolm, and another witness, in a relatively intimate ceremony. Related: John Mulaney Postpones Shows Following Minneapolis ICE Killing: ‘The Situation Is So Unsafe’ How many kids do John Mulaney and Olivia Munn have? The couple share two children: Malcolm (4) and Méi (1). Malcolm was born naturally, while Méi was born via surrogate. Munn shared in an Instagram post of her, Mulaney, and their newborn infant discussing the surrogate journey. “I had so many profound emotions about not being able to carry my daughter. When I first met our gestational surrogate we spoke mother to mother,” Munn says in the caption. “She showed me so much grace and understanding, I knew I had found a real-life angel. Words cannot express my gratitude that she kept our baby safe for 9 months and made our dreams come true. I am so proud of my little plum, my little dragon for making the journey to be with us. My heart has exploded.” Who was John Mulaney married to before Olivia Munn? John Mulaney was married to multimedia artist Anna Marie Tendler from 2014 to 2021. Their divorce was finalized in 2022. What has Mulaney said about his marriage to Munn? Mulaney calls it “the best.” In the Seth Meyers interview, he held up his hand in sheer joy, showing off his wedding band. His mother-in-law was also in the audience, to which he shouted out, “Hi, Mom! I call her Mom now. Like you said, we got married so … I call her Mom now.” Related: Olivia Munn Shares How Kate Middleton’s Words Comforted Her Amid Cancer Journey: ‘I Needed to Hear That’ What has Mulaney said about his kids? On a Dec. 11, 2024, appearance on Jimmy Fallon, Mulaney discussed how he and his son sometimes talk smack about their infant. “It was like when any new person comes into an organization, like when someone starts at work. He and I would sometimes break off to talk about her,” Mulaney jokes to Fallon. He continues, “Sometimes, when she squeaks or does something, I’ll pull him aside. I go, ‘Come here.’ I go, ‘Did you see what Meimei did?’ And he’ll go, ‘She is so weird.’” About the authorRendy Jones is a film and television journalist born and raised in Brooklyn, New York. They are the owner of self-published independent outlet, Rendy Reviews, a member of the Critics’ Choice Association, GALECA, and NYFCO. They have been seen in Entertainment Weekly, Vanity Fair, Them, Roger Ebert and Paste.
